# USWDS Web Components

> Accessible Web Components implementing the U.S. Web Design System for government websites.

## Overview

This library provides constrained Web Components for building government website prototypes with AI assistance. Use ONLY these components—do not create custom HTML structures.

## Installation

```bash
npm install @uswds-wc/all
```

## Quick Start

```html
<script type="module">
  import '@uswds-wc/all';
</script>

<usa-banner></usa-banner>
<usa-header title="Agency Name"></usa-header>
<main class="usa-section">
  <usa-alert type="info">Welcome message</usa-alert>
  <usa-button variant="primary">Get Started</usa-button>
</main>
<usa-footer variant="medium"></usa-footer>
```

## Components

### Actions
- usa-button - Action button (primary, secondary, outline)
- usa-button-group - Group of related buttons
- usa-link - Styled hyperlink
- usa-search - Search form

### Forms
- usa-text-input - Text input field
- usa-textarea - Multi-line text
- usa-select - Dropdown select
- usa-checkbox - Checkbox input
- usa-radio - Radio button
- usa-date-picker - Calendar date picker
- usa-time-picker - Time selection
- usa-combo-box - Searchable dropdown
- usa-file-input - File upload
- usa-range-slider - Range/slider
- usa-memorable-date - Month/Day/Year
- usa-character-count - Input with limit

### Navigation
- usa-header - Site header
- usa-footer - Site footer
- usa-breadcrumb - Breadcrumb navigation
- usa-pagination - Page navigation
- usa-side-navigation - Sidebar nav
- usa-in-page-navigation - Jump links
- usa-language-selector - Language switcher
- usa-skip-link - Accessibility skip link

### Data Display
- usa-card - Content card
- usa-table - Data table
- usa-tag - Status label
- usa-list - Styled list
- usa-icon - USWDS icon
- usa-icon-list - List with icons
- usa-collection - Item collection
- usa-summary-box - Highlighted summary

### Feedback
- usa-alert - Notification (info, success, warning, error)
- usa-site-alert - Page-level alert
- usa-banner - Official government banner
- usa-modal - Dialog window
- usa-tooltip - Hover tooltip

### Layout
- usa-step-indicator - Multi-step progress
- usa-process-list - Numbered steps
- usa-identifier - Agency identifier
- usa-prose - Styled prose content

### Structure
- usa-accordion - Expandable sections

### Patterns
- usa-name-pattern - Full name inputs
- usa-address-pattern - Address form
- usa-phone-number-pattern - Phone input
- usa-email-address-pattern - Email input
- usa-date-of-birth-pattern - DOB inputs
- usa-ssn-pattern - SSN input
- usa-contact-preferences-pattern - Communication prefs
- usa-form-summary-pattern - Form review

## Key Files

- /AI_USAGE.md - Complete component reference for AI agents
- /CLAUDE.md - Development workflow guidelines
- /.github/copilot-instructions.md - GitHub Copilot instructions
- /custom-elements.json - Machine-readable API (run: pnpm analyze)
- /packages/ - Component source code

## Constraints

- Use ONLY components from this library for prototypes
- Apply theming via USWDS utility classes
- Do not create custom CSS or inline styles
- All components use Light DOM (not Shadow DOM)

## Links

- USWDS Design System: https://designsystem.digital.gov/
- Repository: https://github.com/barbaradenney/uswds-wc
